import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets from the input directory
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Extract features and target
X_train = train_df["text"]
y_train = train_df["author"]
X_test = test_df["text"]
ids_test = test_df["id"]

# Split training data into train and validation sets (80/20) for genuine hold-out scoring
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Initialize TF-IDF vectorizer with ngrams to capture author style
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, stop_words="english"
)

# Fit vectorizer on training split only
X_tr_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# Initialize and train Logistic Regression model on training split
model = LogisticRegression(multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
model.fit(X_tr_vec, y_tr)

# Predict probabilities on validation set
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val_vec)

# Calculate and print multi-class log-loss on validation set (genuine hold-out estimate)
val_score = log_loss(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_score}")

# Retrain model on the full training dataset to maximize test performance
X_train_full_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_train)
model.fit(X_train_full_vec, y_train)

# Predict probabilities on test set
y_test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test_vec)

# Prepare submission dataframe
classes = model.classes_
submission_data = {"id": ids_test}
for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
    submission_data[cls] = y_test_pred[:, i]

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data)

# Ensure column order matches the required submission format (id, EAP, HPL, MWS)
submission_df = submission_df[["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]]

# Save submission file
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
